profile.name: Joel Jojy
profile.headline: I design and ship AI-ready product interfaces.
profile.intro: UI/UX designer and frontend builder with 4+ years across SaaS, cybersecurity, hospitality, ecommerce, and portfolio experiences. Open to fully remote product design, UI/UX, and design engineering roles across Europe, UAE, India, and global teams.
profile.currentFocus: Available for remote product design and design engineering roles

about.heading: I turn ambiguous product problems into usable flows, polished UI systems, and frontend that can actually ship.
about.copy: My sweet spot is the space between product design and implementation: mapping messy workflows, designing interaction systems, prototyping fast, and using AI coding tools to move from Figma-level intent to live product surfaces.
focus: Product design for SaaS, AI-native tools, dashboards, and service experiences.
UX flows, information architecture, interaction states, and visual systems.
Frontend implementation with React, modern CSS, responsive layouts, and AI-assisted development.
Agent-ready documentation: design rules, reusable components, and patterns teams can keep consistent.

approach.title: Clarify the product job
approach.copy: I start with the outcome, user pressure, business goal, and constraints, then turn that into the smallest useful product decision.

approach.title: Map flows and edge cases
approach.copy: I design the route through the product, including empty states, approvals, errors, recovery, and the small moments that make tools feel trustworthy.

approach.title: Prototype and ship
approach.copy: I move quickly from interface direction to responsive prototypes or frontend-ready implementation, using AI tools as leverage while keeping design judgment human.

approach.title: Systemize the result
approach.copy: I convert the best decisions into reusable components, interaction rules, and documentation that help teams and agents produce consistent work.

worksIntro: Selected work focused on product thinking, interface craft, frontend delivery, and NDA-safe proof where private product surfaces cannot be shown.

projects.title: Vaytrion / Aegis Graph
projects.summary: Designing the product experience for Aegis Graph, Vaytrion's cloud security remediation platform that maps blast radius, fixes safe misconfigurations, and explains every decision with an audit trail. Detailed product screens are under NDA until seed funding, so the public website is the current showcase.

projects.title: Inspire Media
projects.summary: Photography and film portfolio for a Dubai-based studio, built with an infinite draggable gallery, looping video previews, category collections, full-length playback, responsive layouts, and a motion-led UX case study that explains the product story.

projects.title: Maha Meru Innovations
projects.summary: Animated UX case-study direction and digital platform work for an agritech brand, balancing premium brand storytelling with clear product discovery and commerce flows.

projects.title: Cafe Meadows
projects.summary: A digital menu and ordering experience for a Dubai cafe, focused on fast browsing, visual item discovery, responsive behavior, and a smoother path from menu exploration to order intent.

projects.title: Cinematic Portfolio Experience
projects.summary: A designed and developed portfolio experience with cinematic pacing, atmospheric interaction, and a visual rhythm built around frames rather than a standard scroll page.

caseStudies.copy: A motion-led case study for a Dubai creative studio portfolio, showing how media discovery, video previews, category browsing, full-length playback, and responsive storytelling were shaped into one polished product experience.
